title_zh: 特温特队在直布罗陀以4-1大胜，保持欧战开局全胜。
description: FC Twente defeated Lincoln Red Imps F.C. 4-1 on Thursday in the UEFA Conference League league stage.
description_zh: 周四，在欧足联联盟联赛阶段的比赛中，特温特足球俱乐部以 4-1 击败了林肯红魔足球俱乐部。

title: West Nile virus infections reach 72 as mosquito season ends
title_zh: 随着蚊虫活跃期结束，西尼罗河病毒感染病例增至72例。
description: The number of confirmed West Nile virus infections in the Netherlands has risen to 72 this year after eight additional cases were recorded last week, according to the National Institute for Public
description_zh: 据荷兰国家公共卫生研究所称，上周新增8例西尼罗河病毒感染病例后，荷兰今年确诊的西尼罗河病毒感染病例已增至72例。

title: NEC Nijmegen beat Dinamo Zagreb 4-2 for first UEFA Europa League win
title_zh: NEC奈梅亨4-2击败萨格勒布迪纳摩，取得首场欧联杯胜利
description: NEC Nijmegen gained a vital victory on Thursday in the UEFA Europa League. Dick Schreuder’s side defeated Dinamo Zagreb 4-2 in the Maksimir stadium.
description_zh: 周四，奈梅亨NEC队在欧联杯中取得了一场至关重要的胜利。迪克·施罗德率领的球队在马克西米尔球场以4-2击败了萨格勒布迪纳摩队。

title: Spike in new freelancers behind 15% increase in new businesses; Biggest jump in years
title_zh: 自由职业者数量激增推动新企业数量增长15%，创多年来最大增幅。
description: The number of new businesses in the Netherlands rose by 15 percent in the third quarter of this year compared to a year earlier - the sharpest increase in years.
description_zh: 今年第三季度，荷兰新企业数量比上年同期增长了 15%，这是多年来的最大增幅。

title: AZ beat Ararat-Armenia 4-0 for second straight Europa League win
title_zh: AZ 4-0 击败亚美尼亚阿拉拉特，取得欧联杯两连胜
description: AZ Alkmaar secured a convincing 4-0 away win over Ararat-Armenia in the UEFA Europa League on Thursday.
description_zh: 周四，阿尔克马尔在欧足联欧洲联赛中客场以 4-0 大胜亚美尼亚阿拉拉特。

title: U.S. baseball World Series to feature Dutch international and former national coach
title_zh: 美国棒球世界大赛将迎来荷兰国脚兼前国家队教练的身影
description: The World Series has a Dutch connection this season, with Dutch baseball international Richie Palacios set to face the Milwaukee Brewers in the Major League Baseball (MLB) final.
description_zh: 本赛季的世界大赛与荷兰有着某种联系，荷兰棒球国手里奇·帕拉西奥斯将代表荷兰队参加美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）总决赛，对阵密尔沃基酿酒人队。

title: Two pythons found by Amsterdam police trapped in towed car with box of mice
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹警方在一辆拖车里发现两条蟒蛇，车里还有一盒老鼠。
description: Amsterdam police's transport team made an unusual discovery on Wednesday while carrying out a routine vehicle relocation, they reported on
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹警方交通运输小组周三在进行例行车辆调配时，有了一个不同寻常的发现，他们报告称。

title: Hope for nearly bankrupt seal center as Groningen province offers help
title_zh: 格罗宁根省伸出援手，为濒临破产的海豹中心带来希望
description: There is still hope for the struggling seal center Wadden Sea World Heritage Centre (WEC), formerly the Pieterburen Seal Center.
description_zh: 瓦登海世界遗产中心（WEC，前身为彼得布伦海豹中心）目前处境艰难，但仍有希望挽救其海豹保护工作。

title: International Criminal Court wins European Parliament's Sakharov Prize
title_zh: 国际刑事法院荣获欧洲议会萨哈罗夫奖
description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has been named the recipient of this year's Sakharov Prize by the European Parliament. The human rights award will be formally presented in December.
description_zh: 欧洲议会宣布，国际刑事法院（ICC）荣获今年的萨哈罗夫奖。这项人权奖将于12月正式颁发。

title: Military to help maintain order around asylum registration center in Ter Apel
title_zh: 军方将协助维护特尔阿佩尔庇护登记中心周边的秩序
description: The municipality of Westerwolde has asked the Ministry of Defense to deploy Koninklijke Marechaussee officers to help maintain order around the overcrowded asylum registration center in T
description_zh: 韦斯特沃尔德市政府已请求国防部部署皇家宪兵队，协助维护位于T镇的过度拥挤的难民登记中心周围的秩序。

title: Hoorn dance instructor convicted of sexually abusing two girls gets 2.5 years in prison
title_zh: 霍恩市一名舞蹈教练因性侵两名女孩被判入狱两年半。
description: A court of appeal has sentenced Kurt F., a 42-year-old dance instructor from Hoorn, to 2.5 years in prison and a five-year ban on working in his profession for sexually abusing two minors.
description_zh: 上诉法院判处来自霍恩的 42 岁舞蹈教练库尔特·F 2.5 年监禁，并禁止其在五年内从事舞蹈相关职业，罪名是性侵两名未成年人。

title: “Help... He is killing me”: Missing woman Hajar sent frantic plea before Amsterdam death
title_zh: “救命……他要杀了我”：失踪女子哈贾尔在阿姆斯特丹遇害前发出绝望求救信号
description: The 29-year-old Amsterdam woman who was found murdered two weeks after she was reported missing sent text messages to a family member begging for help the last day she was seen. “Help me. Now.
description_zh: 一名29岁的阿姆斯特丹女子在失踪两周后被发现遇害。在她最后一次被人看到的那一天，她曾给一位家人发短信求助：“救救我。现在就救我。”

title: Vast majority of hard drug users don’t think about crime that got their drugs to them
title_zh: 绝大多数吸食硬性毒品的人都不会去想是什么犯罪手段让他们获得了毒品。
description: Eighty-seven percent of young hard-drug users - a majority - are barely or not at all aware that their consumption forms part of a broader illegal drug market.
description_zh: 87% 的年轻硬性毒品使用者（占大多数）几乎没有意识到或完全没有意识到他们的消费行为是更广泛的非法毒品市场的一部分。

title: Unions call off bus and regional train strikes for two weeks
title_zh: 工会取消公交车和区域火车罢工两周
description: Unions FNV and CNV have suspended their weekly strikes in regional public transport for two weeks after employers made new...
description_zh: 在雇主提出新的要求后，FNV 和 CNV 工会暂停了在地区公共交通领域每周举行的罢工，为期两周……

title: Gambling regulator hits illegal casino with record €37m fine
title_zh: 博彩监管机构对非法赌场处以创纪录的3700万欧元罚款
description: The Dutch gambling regulator KSA has issued a record fine of €37 million on a company for running a dozen...
description_zh: 荷兰博彩监管机构KSA对一家公司处以创纪录的3700万欧元罚款，原因是该公司运营十几家赌场……

title: Heerlen man suspected of stealing 25,000 euros in IKEA goods with staff help
title_zh: 一名来自海尔伦的男子涉嫌在宜家员工的帮助下盗窃价值2.5万欧元的商品。
description: A 31-year-old from Heerlen is accused of stealing almost €25,000 worth of items from IKEA.
description_zh: 一名来自海尔伦的 31 岁男子被指控从宜家盗窃价值近 25,000 欧元的物品。

title: Female executives remain scarce at Dutch listed companies, report finds
title_zh: 报告显示，荷兰上市公司中女性高管仍然寥寥无几。
description: Progress in increasing female representation on the boards of Dutch listed companies has largely stalled, according to the 2026 Female Board Index.
description_zh: 根据 2026 年女性董事会指数，荷兰上市公司董事会中女性代表人数增加的进展已基本停滞。

title: Dutch Gambling Authority issues record 37 million euro fine to illegal casino operator
title_zh: 荷兰博彩管理局对非法赌场运营商处以创纪录的3700万欧元罚款。
description: The Dutch Gambling Authority (Ksa) has issued a record fine to an illegal party that was offering gambling in the Netherlands without a license on various websites, including Instantcasino and Skyh
description_zh: 荷兰博彩管理局 (Ksa) 对一家非法机构处以创纪录的罚款，该机构在未获得许可的情况下，通过包括 Instantcasino 和 Skyh 在内的多个网站在荷兰提供赌博服务。

title: Airbnb to hosts: no more asking guests to wash the dishes
title_zh: 爱彼迎对房东说：不得再要求房客洗碗。
description: In addition to increasingly strict rules for hosts renting out their homes on Airbnb – including limits on the number...
description_zh: 除了对通过 Airbnb 出租房屋的房东制定了越来越严格的规定——包括限制房源数量……

title: Get help with careers, homes and more at IamExpat Fair The Hague
title_zh: 在海牙 IamExpat 博览会上获取职业、住房等方面的帮助。
description: The IamExpat Fair is returning to the Grote Kerk in The Hague on Saturday November 7 with more exhibitors than...
description_zh: IamExpat 博览会将于 11 月 7 日星期六重返海牙大教堂，参展商数量将比以往更多……

title: Police shut 30 web shops linked to counterfeit pill deaths
title_zh: 警方关闭了30家与假药致死事件有关的网店
description: Thirty websites were taken offline and three men arrested earlier this week in connection to sites that sold counterfeit pills...
description_zh: 本周早些时候，30个销售假药的网站被关闭，三名男子被捕……

title: Are you financially fit for your life in the Netherlands?
title_zh: 你的经济状况是否足以支撑你在荷兰的生活？
description: New to the Netherlands or a longer-term resident looking to get your finances organised to make the most of your...
description_zh: 无论您是初来荷兰，还是长期居住在荷兰，想要整理好财务以充分利用您的……

title: Afghans washed up on Texel were human smuggling victims
title_zh: 在特塞尔岛搁浅的阿富汗人是人口走私的受害者。
description: Two Afghan men whose body parts washed ashore on Texel in 2023 were victims of a vast human smuggling network...
description_zh: 2023年，两名阿富汗男子的残肢被冲上特塞尔岛海岸，他们是庞大的人口走私网络的受害者……

title: Construction sector needs 73,000 more workers, partly due to Defense expansion plans
title_zh: 建筑业需要新增73000名工人，部分原因是国防扩建计划。
description: The construction sector will need approximately 73,000 new workers over the next three years, according to the Economic Institute for Construction (EIB).
description_zh: 根据欧洲建筑经济研究所（EIB）的数据，未来三年建筑业大约需要73000名新工人。

title: Dutch police take down 30 illegal medicines sites after fake oxycodone kills three
title_zh: 荷兰警方查封30个非法药品网站，此前假冒羟考酮导致三人死亡。
description: The police arrested three men and took down 30 websites selling illegal medicines and hard drugs in an investigation launched after three people died within a short period.
description_zh: 在短时间内有三人死亡后，警方展开调查，逮捕了三名男子，并查封了 30 个销售非法药品和毒品的网站。

title: Environmental orgs., locals preparing lawsuit for lower flight cap for Schiphol Airport
title_zh: 环保组织和当地居民准备提起诉讼，要求降低史基浦机场的航班上限。
description: Six environmental organizations and residents’ associations are preparing to fight the new Airport Traffic Decree (LVB) in a lawsuit filed with the Council of State.
description_zh: 六个环保组织和居民协会正准备向国务委员会提起诉讼，反对新的机场交通法令（LVB）。

title: Patients federation warns higher premiums will push more people into financial trouble
title_zh: 患者联盟警告称，保费上涨将使更多人陷入经济困境。
description: The sharpest rise in health insurance premiums in years will make planned healthcare cuts even harder for patients to bear, the Dutch Patients Federation warned on Wednesday.
description_zh: 荷兰患者联合会周三警告称，多年来医疗保险费的最大涨幅将使计划中的医疗保健削减措施对患者来说更加难以承受。

title: Netflix releases trailer for documentary series on Natalee Holloway
title_zh: Netflix发布了关于娜塔莉·霍洛威的纪录片系列预告片
description: Netflix has published the trailer for its upcoming three-part documentary series on Natalee Holloway, who
description_zh: Netflix发布了即将推出的关于娜塔莉·霍洛威的三集纪录片的预告片。
